limits_of_proven.shared_futex_wait: the filter lets through FUTEX_WAIT_BITSET with the wall clock (operation 265), a wait that is not private, because the C library's thread join makes it on a thread's id (the kernel wakes that word in its form that is not private when the thread ends, and refusing it ends the free-threaded interpreter at its first join): another process that maps the same page of a file, a helper started before the wall among them, can learn through it whether this process waits there, one bit at a time; the wait wakes no process, and every wake that is not private is refused
limits_of_proven.what_the_process_shows: a process started before the wall and no longer this one's child is not seen by the probe: it can read this process's command line, which lives in this process's own memory, and its times and state in /proc, which no call of this process changes; the host must start no process before the wall
limits_of_proven.page_cache_residency: another process that maps a file this one reads can learn from the kernel's page cache which pages of the file this process brought into memory, one page at a time

held_objects_not_tried.shared_map: a map is not a descriptor, so the close step cannot reach it
held_objects_not_tried.namespace: entering a namespace changes the whole process the host runs in
